test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

According to the teacher, **the Earth is revolving. **

options.text: spoke that the Earth is round
said that the Earth is round

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The bold part of the sentence, "the Earth is revolving," is can be replaced with 'the earth is round.'
 
• The teacher is explaining that the Earth is round, which requires the use of the appropriate verb "said."
 
• Option 3, "the Earth is round," is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning clearly.
 
• Other options either introduce grammatical errors or fail to accurately express the intended meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"According to the teacher, the Earth is round."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "spoke that the Earth is round" is incorrect because "spoke" is not typically followed by "that."
 
• **Option 2:** "said that the Earth is round" is grammatically correct but does not improve the sentence effectively.
 
• **Option 4:** "told that Earth was round" is incorrect because "told" requires an indirect object (e.g., "told someone").
